in_marathi.name: Sagun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sagun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sagun is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Sa-gun’ which means 'Grace' or 'Fortune'. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring good luck and prosperity to the bearer.
